from pwn import *
from base64 import b64decode, b64encode
from bls.scheme import setup, aggregate_vk, aggregate_sigma
from bplib.bp import G2Elem, G1Elem

def parse_public_key(b64key, group):
    return G2Elem.from_bytes(b64decode(b64key), group)

def parse_signature(b64sig, group):
    return G1Elem.from_bytes(b64decode(b64sig), group)

def interact_with_server():
    # Connect to the challenge server
    server = remote("crypto.chal.csaw.io", 8000)

    # Collect initial keys and parse them
    welcome_message = server.recvuntil(b"Chester\n")
    keys = welcome_message.split(b"\n")[-4:-1]
    params = setup()

    vks = [parse_public_key(key.decode(), params[0]) for key in keys]

    # Interact with Abraham for "ham" signature
    server.sendline(b"1")
    server.recvuntil(b"is it ham? I love ham!\n")
    server.sendline(b"ham")
    server.recvuntil(b"sure thing\n")
    ham_signature = parse_signature(server.recvline().decode().strip(), params[0])

    # Interact with Chester for "this stuff" signature
    server.sendline(b"3")
    server.recvuntil(
        b"you sure this is legal? are you with the atf? the fda? are you high right now? do you ever get nervous?\n"

    server.sendline(b"this stuff")
    server.recvuntil(b"ok, sure\n")
    this_stuff_signature = parse_signature(server.recvline().decode().strip(), params[0])

    # Submit the first signature (ham)

    server.sendline(b64encode(ham_signature.export()))

    server.recvuntil(b"and who is this from (the public key, if you please)?\n")
    server.sendline(b64encode(vks[0].export()))

    # Submit the second signature (this stuff)
    server.recvuntil(b"OK, and the second?\n")
    server.sendline(b64encode(this_stuff_signature.export()))

    server.recvuntil(b"who gave you this one (again, by public key)?\n")
    server.sendline(b64encode(vks[2].export()))

    # Provide Bernice's public key as the missing admin
    server.recvuntil(b"who didn't sign? We need their public key to run everything\n")
    server.sendline(b64encode(vks[1].export()))

    # Retrieve and print the flag
    flag_response = server.recvline().decode()
    server.close()

    return flag_response
